items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'll never forget -- do you remember when Ralph Cooper was the Master of Ceremonies... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Who am I confusing him with?

I'll never forget -- do you remember when Ralph Cooper was the Master of Ceremonies for a broadcast of the Kraft Cheese Company and they had Lionel Hampton and he went off playing, 'Flying Home' with the great Arnett Cobb.
